evidence.mission_note: A GX460 supplies body-on-frame, low-range capability and a sleeping-platform or rooftop-tent base that the RX 350 lacks, so it fits the utility branch. Its fit depends on the Ohio frame being sound.
evidence.rationale: The listing establishes a 2017 GX460 Premium in silver over black with 128,500 claimed miles, a claimed clean title, and visible mild cosmetic changes: aftermarket black wheels, all-terrain tires and dash RAM mounts. The photos show a clean, detailed exterior and engine bay, plus moderate wear on the driver bolster and steering wheel. Every model-critical item remains open. There is no VIN or history report, and the full maintenance records and yearly Krown treatments are claimed but not shown. There are no frame photos for a rust-belt car, and the air-injection and KDSS history are not mentioned. The $23,900 ask sits slightly above the $22,964 fair-value mid and has been on the market for months after a reported $3,000 cut. For the capability mission it supplies what the RX lacks: body-on-frame construction, low range, roof crossbars, a hitch and a fold-flat cargo floor.
evidence.next_action: Message the seller for the VIN, photos of the maintenance and Krown records, underside/frame photos, and confirmation that an independent PPI is allowed before any deposit.
